messages.content:
<document id=DOC_req_years_eight>
Required: 8 years of backend engineering experience.
</document>

<document id=DOC_summary_no_dates>
Backend engineering across transactional services, most recently a
settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day. Previously worked on
payment reconciliation and inventory systems.
</document>

Rewrite the candidate summary above to match the posting requirement.

If years of experience are neither stated nor calculable, ask me for the
figure and tell me what it costs not to supply it.

response.text:
The job posting requires 8 years of backend engineering experience, but the candidate summary does not state or allow calculation of years of experience.

Not supplying the years costs your submission credibility—many employers will screen you out automatically if your experience isn't clearly quantified.

Please tell me how many years of backend engineering experience the candidate has so I can revise the summary to match the requirement.
